_readme: The Holiday page, all of it. Edit freely; keep the quotes and commas.
from / to: travel days, YYYY-MM-DD. flights and base: fill in once booked, empty shows 'to be booked'.
crew: ids from squad.csv who are coming; empty shows the whole active squad.
spots: the pins on the island. kind is one of Beach, Boat, Hike, Town, History.
days: one per date, the plan is a draft until you say otherwise.
weather: April averages for Sardinia from weather2travel.com/sardinia/april/.

spots.name: Cala Goloritzé
spots.text: A white pebble cove under a limestone spire, reached on foot down a long trail and worth every step back up.

spots.name: Cala Luna
spots.text: Caves, cliffs and turquoise water. Boats leave from Cala Gonone and stop at the coves along the gulf.

spots.name: Gola su Gorropu
spots.text: One of the deepest canyons in Europe, with walls of a few hundred metres. Proper shoes, plenty of water.

spots.name: Tiscali
spots.text: The remains of a Nuragic village hidden inside a collapsed limestone mountain. A hike in, a time machine once there.

spots.name: Orgosolo
spots.text: A mountain town covered in political murals. Stay for a long lunch in the hills.

spots.name: La Maddalena
spots.text: An archipelago of granite islands and impossibly clear water, best seen from a boat for the day.

spots.name: Porto Cervo
spots.text: Superyachts, an aperitivo with a view, and prices to match. Go once, for the stories.

spots.name: Capo Testa
spots.text: Wind-sculpted granite boulders on a headland looking out to Corsica. Sunset here is the move.

spots.name: Castelsardo
spots.text: A castle town piled up on a rock above the sea, with alleys full of woven baskets.

spots.name: La Pelosa
spots.text: Shallow, glassy water and a tower on a rock. It gets summer booking rules, so check before going.

spots.name: Neptune's Grotto
spots.text: A sea cave with a salt lake inside. Reach it by boat from Alghero or by a long staircase down the cliff.

spots.name: Alghero
spots.text: Old sea walls, Catalan streets and the island's best sunset strip for a drink.

spots.name: Bosa
spots.text: Pastel houses stacked up a hill along the river, with a castle on top.

spots.name: Is Arutas
spots.text: A beach made of little grains of quartz instead of sand: white, pink and green.

spots.name: Su Nuraxi
spots.text: The best-known nuraghe, a Bronze Age stone fortress and a UNESCO World Heritage site.

spots.name: Cagliari & Poetto
spots.text: The capital: an old quarter on the hill, flamingos in the lagoon and a long city beach.

spots.name: Chia & Tuerredda
spots.text: Dunes, juniper and some of the clearest water on the island.

days.title: Arrivo
days.plan: Land, pick up the cars, find the house. First Ichnusa as the sun goes down.

days.title: Spiaggia
days.plan: Slow start, a beach, a very long lunch.

days.title: In barca
days.plan: A day on a boat: coves, caves and a swim if anyone dares the water.

days.title: Trekking
days.plan: A hike: a canyon, a cove or a granite headland.

days.title: Nuraghi
days.plan: Stone towers older than Rome, then porceddu for dinner.

days.title: Partita
days.plan: The CTB beach tournament. Losers do the dishes.

days.title: Ultima sera
days.plan: Aperitivo in an old town, a big last dinner, A kent'annos.

days.title: Ritorno
days.plan: Last espresso, last look at the sea, fly home.

menu.en: Suckling pig slow-roasted over myrtle and juniper wood
Hand-pinched pasta filled with potato, pecorino and mint
Little ridged gnocchi with a sausage and saffron ragù
Cured mullet roe, grated over pasta
Fried pastry with cheese inside and honey on top
The red wine of the island

phrases.mean: To a hundred years! The Sardinian toast.

packing: A warm layer for the evenings
